title_seed: Client timeout 不是研究失敗
central_problem: 長時間 acquisition 在 client wait 結束後，如何仍然保留可追蹤的研究狀態？
reader_takeaway: terminal state、revision、checkpoint、resume 與 client wait 必須各自有語義。

known_at_the_time.fact: V4 official run had all 10 fresh jobs reach explicit terminal states。
the run reported 1/10 validated LIMITED-or-better and 0/10 FORMAL, so generalization remained false。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: terminal status was explicit/immutable; checkpointed artifacts, idempotent resume and unknown downstream counts were preserved。

not_yet_available.fact: all jobs reaching terminal does not mean all jobs had qualifying full text or formal reports。

observed_failures.symptom: 53 bounded client-wait expirations and 3 poll transport timeouts occurred while jobs later reached terminal states
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: client observation ceiling was shorter than durable acquisition work
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: wait expiry must not be mapped to zero evidence
observed_failures.later_resolution: explicit terminal manifests and job retrieval separated observation from research state

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: All 10 jobs reached explicit terminal states; the same run reported 1/10 LIMITED-or-better, 0/10 FORMAL, 53 client-wait expirations and 3 poll timeouts.
tests_and_metrics.result: lifecycle terminality separated from content qualification

engineering_decisions.decision: 讓 job lifecycle 由 durable repository/manifest 管理，讓 client wait 只描述 client observation。

architecture_state.state: create job → checkpointed acquisition → terminal manifest/revision → later retrieval/projection

safe_public_facts.fact: 一個 client request 結束等待，不代表 server-side research job 已經失敗。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來 canonical projections 還要校正各 consumer 對 admission 的理解；V4 只先解 lifecycle ownership。

publication_risks: 不要用 client timeout 數量當內容失敗數量。
不要把 terminal 10/10 寫成 formal 10/10。
